# Option reference (generated)

<!-- Generated by `ultrafast reference -o docs/reference/options.md` from the engine's option registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every key the engine reads, with its JSON type, SI unit, default and meaning. The same registry produces the
JSON Schemas (`schemas/`, [Schemas](schema.md)) and the unknown-key warnings, so this page is complete by construction.
Units: the key suffix names the unit (`lengthM` metres, `durationFwhmS` seconds, `gddFs2` fs²).

## System file

Top-level keys of a `.ufs` system file.

An optical system: a chain of elements. More: [system-file.md](system-file.md)

| key | type | unit | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | string |  |  | "ultrafast-system" |
| `version` | integer |  | 2 | Format version |
| `name` | string |  |  | Name of the system |
| `description` | string |  |  | Free text |
| `source` | object |  |  | Provenance of the file (written by exporters, e.g. the zemax plugin); free-form |
| `sampling` | object (`samplingWavelengths`) |  |  | Wavelengths of all per-wavelength arrays in the file |
| `environment` | object (`environment`) |  |  | Air of the laboratory and the index reference of quoted data |
| `materials` | object |  |  | Materials defined in this file, by name (docs/reference/materials.md) |
| `coatings` | object |  |  | Coatings defined in this file, by name (docs/reference/coatings.md) |
| `inputBeam` | model (beam) |  |  | Default beam for nonlinear elements without one |
| `elements` | array of `element` |  |  | The beam path, in order **Required.** |
| `overrides` | array of `override` |  |  | Changes to models or values (docs/reference/models.md#overrides) |

## Pulse

`run.pulse`.

The input pulse (docs/reference/run-spec.md#pulse).

| key | type | unit | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `shape` | `"gaussian"` \| `"sech2"` \| `"superGaussian"` \| `"spectrum"` |  | gaussian | Pulse shape |
| `centerWavelengthM` | number | m |  | Carrier wavelength (for spectrum: default = intensity-weighted mean) |
| `centerWavelengthNm` | number | nm |  | Carrier wavelength in nm (alternative) |
| `durationFwhmS` | number | s |  | Transform-limited intensity FWHM |
| `durationFwhmFs` | number | fs |  | Transform-limited FWHM in fs (alternative) |
| `bandwidthFwhmM` | number | m |  | Spectral FWHM (alternative to the duration) |
| `bandwidthFwhmNm` | number | nm |  | Spectral FWHM in nm |
| `order` | integer |  | 2 | superGaussian order |
| `energyJ` | number | J |  | Pulse energy |
| `averagePowerW` | number | W |  | Average power (with repRateHz) |
| `peakPowerW` | number | W |  | Peak power (alternative) |
| `repRateHz` | number | Hz |  | Repetition rate |
| `chirp` | object (`chirp`) |  |  | Spectral phase about the carrier: gddS2/todS3/fodS4 or gddFs2/todFs3/fodFs4 |
| `polarization` | any |  | "x" | "x", "y", "45", "-45", "rcp", "lcp", {angleDeg, ellipticity} or [exRe, exIm, eyRe, eyIm] |
| `spectrum` | object (`pulseSpectrum`) |  |  | Measured spectrum (shape: spectrum): wavelengthsM + intensity (+ phaseRad), or csv |
| `delayS` | number | s | 0 | Time offset |
| `pedestal` | any |  |  | Pedestal / contrast components: one object or a list (replica, prePulse, postPulse, ase, phaseNoise, exponential) |

## Grid

`run.grid`.

The time/frequency grid (docs/reference/run-spec.md#grid).

| key | type | unit | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `auto` | boolean |  | true | Size the grid from pulse and system |
| `n` | integer |  | 4096 | Number of samples (with auto: a minimum) |
| `windowS` | number | s | 30 x the transform limit | Time window |
| `windowPs` | number | ps |  | Time window in ps |
| `maxN` | integer |  | 4194304 | Largest allowed n |
| `snapCarrier` | boolean |  | true | Put the carrier on the frequency grid |
| `spectralMargin` | number |  | auto | Spectral span factor |
| `minSpanFraction` | number |  | 0.1 | Nonlinear runs: minimum half-span / carrier |
| `minPointsPerFwhm` | number |  | 12 | Samples across the transform-limited FWHM |

## Physics

`run.physics`.

Physics switches (docs/reference/run-spec.md#physics).

| key | type | unit | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `nonlinear` | boolean |  | true | Master switch for nonlinear propagation |
| `selfSteepening` | boolean |  | true | Self-steepening |
| `raman` | boolean |  | true | Delayed (Raman) response of materials that have one |
| `fieldMode` | `"auto"` \| `"envelope"` \| `"carrier"` |  | auto | Envelope or carrier-resolved (real field) propagation |
| `fieldHarmonic` | number |  | 3 | Highest harmonic the carrier-resolved grid holds |
| `absoluteIndex` | boolean |  | true | Add air dispersion to air paths quoted relative to air |
| `polarization` | `"jones"` \| `"scalar"` |  | jones | Jones (two polarisations) or scalar |
| `losses` | boolean |  | true | false removes flat loss terms |
| `beamTracking` | any |  | "auto" | Gaussian beam (q) tracking: "auto" (on with a Gaussian inputBeam), "on", "off" |
| `transverse` | object (`transverse`) |  |  | Default spatial model for every bulk/gap/crystal without one |
| `ionization` | any |  | false | Photo-ionisation and plasma in every nonlinear bulk element: true or an ionization object |

`run.stepper`.

| key | type | unit | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| `maxSteps` | integer |  |  | Step limit per element |
| `steps` | integer |  |  | Fixed number of steps (rk4ip) |

| `centerXM` | number | m | 0 | Sensor centre x |
| `centerYM` | number | m | 0 | Sensor centre y |
| `propagateM` | number | m |  | Free-space propagation before imaging (v1 key) |
| `magnification` | number |  |  | Magnification (v1 key) |
| `focalLengthM` | number | m |  | Far-field focal length (v1 key) |

## Common instrument keys

Keys every instrument accepts (core and plugins).

### `core`

Keys every instrument accepts.

| key | type | unit | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | string |  |  | Instrument kind **Required.** |
| `name` | string |  | kind_at | Name in the results (unique; repeated names get _2, _3) |
| `at` | string |  | "end" | "input", an element id (after that element) or "end" |
| `sampling` | object (`sampling`) |  |  | What part of the beam the instrument sees: near / far field, pinhole, fibre, slit (non-imaging instruments) |
| `beam` | model (beam) |  |  | Beam model for 1-D locations (cameras, sampling): the instrument images this ideal Gaussian |

### `fitting` — plugin: fitting

| key | type | unit | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `measured` | object (`fitting:measured`) |  |  | Recorded data to compare this instrument with: a file name, or an object (file, columns, normalize, sigma, background, rangeX, units, values, weight). Fitting plugin. |

## Plugin keys (run spec)

### `fitting` — plugin: fitting

| key | type | unit | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fit` | object (`fitting:fit`) |  |  | Calibrate parameters against every instrument with measured data (fitting plugin). |
